checks.reason: The extant text 吾處汝國久，恨不殺汝 keeps its word-by-word rendering ('I regret not killing you'), and the Chinese is not changed. The bracketed note is clearly marked as philological and matches the supplied 晉書斠注 quote. 御覽七百四十四 cites 前燕錄 with 誓不殺汝. 通鑑 has 恨恨不欲殺汝, glossed 恨恨 as 相戀之情. 斠注 suspects (疑) that 恨不殺汝 is a garbled, defective form of that phrase. 'Probably corrupt' fairly reflects 疑, and both glosses are accurate. This avoids a silent emendation in the English. 'A long time' for 久 is fine. The idiomatic field ('I should have killed you') follows the extant text and is left alone, which is consistent with the literal field.
checks.after: I have dwelt in your state a long time; I regret not killing you [the extant text 恨不殺汝 is probably corrupt (晉書斠注): the Tongjian reads 恨恨不欲殺汝, “with lingering attachment I do not wish to kill you”; Yulan 744, quoting the 前燕錄, reads 誓不殺汝, “I swear not to kill you”].

checks.reason: In 何事非君，何使非民 (Mencius 萬章下 and 公孫丑上), 事 is serving a ruler and 使 is employing or commanding people. 'Whom may I not serve as ruler? What people may I not command?' matches the supplied Mencius parallel and the standard Legge reading. The current 'What affair is not that of the lord? What people are not his subjects?' is a definite misreading. 以匏瓜自喻 is now 'likened himself to a bottle gourd' (匏瓜, Analects 17.7). 聖賢尚如此，況吾曹乎 is now 'If even sages and worthies acted thus, how much more should we!', which correctly restores 賢. The open quotation still closes in s0194. No names, dates or people change.
checks.after: Yang Yu told his friend Cheng Pan, "Confucius welcomed Bi Xi's summons and likened himself to a bottle gourd; Yi Yin also said, 'Whom may I not serve as ruler? What people may I not command?' If even sages and worthies acted thus, how much more should we!

checks.reason: This is the same reading as the idiomatic field, as the repeated-use note requires. 何事非君 is 'Whom may I not serve as ruler?' and 何使非民 is 'What people may I not command?'. 以匏瓜自喻 is 'used the bottle gourd as a metaphor for himself', 聖賢 is 'sages and worthies', and 況吾曹乎 is 'how much more our sort'. 喜佛肸之召 is 'welcomed Bi Xi’s summons'. The current 'what affair is not lord, what people not subjects' is a definite mistranslation of the Mencius quotation. The rest of the sentence is complete, and the open quotation still closes in s0194.
checks.after: Yu told his friend Cheng Pan: “Confucius welcomed Bi Xi’s summons and used the bottle gourd as a metaphor for himself; Yi Yin also said, ‘Whom may I not serve as ruler? What people may I not command?’ If even sages and worthies were like this, how much more our sort!

checks.reason: In 皆豫其謀, 豫 is used for 與, 'to take part in'. It is the standard idiom 豫其謀, 'took part in the plans'. 'Both he pre-planned their strategies' wrongly reads 豫 as 'beforehand'. 'In both he took part in the planning' is correct and agrees with the idiomatic 'He helped plan'. 東破高句麗，北滅宇文歸 and 皝甚器重之 are unchanged, and Yuwen Gui is kept as he is in s0164 and s0165.
checks.after: East defeated Goguryeo, north destroyed Yuwen Gui—in both he took part in the planning; Huang greatly prized and employed him.

additionalCorrections.before: Although Yu served Huang daily nearer, favor and rank above the old men’s, nature humble and respectful, clear and frugal, firm, simple, kind, and earnest; although passed through dwelling at court’s apex, like a scholar in plain cloth.
additionalCorrections.after: Although Yu’s days serving Huang were recent, favor and rank above the old men’s, nature humble and respectful, clear and frugal, firm, simple, kind, and earnest; although passed through dwelling at court’s apex, like a scholar in plain cloth.
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: In 裕雖仕皝日近，寵秩在舊人之右, 日近 means his days in Huang's service were recent, that is, he had served only a short time. 雖 sets this against 寵秩在舊人之右: although a newcomer, his favor and rank were above the old retainers (舊人). 'Served Huang daily nearer' and 'grew daily closer' misread 日近 as growing closeness and lose the contrast with 舊人. Only that clause changes; the rest of the sentence is kept word for word.
